games.name: Area 47: Roleplay
games.desc:
SCP - Area 47: Roleplay Welcome to Armed SCP Containment Area 47, a Role-Playing game for all things SCP!

This game is based on the SCP genre, and is a facility containing the most dangerous SCPs. The SCP Foundation is a multi-government collaboration to protect humanity. Contained in the facility are SCP Creatures of horror, SCP Monsters that could destroy the world if they ever escape. 

In this SCP Site Roleplay, you can play as all kinds of roles like Class - D, Scientist, Mobile Task Force, Security Department, and many more! Through playing these various roles, level up your keycard clearance in the Foundation, and assist in creating the most secure SCP Facility to exist.

Want to learn more about the Foundation, and get some special in-game perks? Join our group! https://www.roblox.com/groups/2760782/SCPF

games.name: Pears to Pairs Card Game
games.desc:
Welcome to Pears to Pairs, a simple, fun, and hilarious tabletop card game! 🍐

The rules for the game are simple. Each player is given a random set of cards that are objects/phrases. At the start of each round, a judge is selected along with a random card, an adjective. Your goal? Select a card that you think the judge will pair with their card to win! 🏆

With 1500+ different game cards and various game modes, you are sure to come up with crazy card combinations and have endless hours of fun! At least 3 players in a server are needed to play. 🎮

With full device cross compatibility, you can play the game on the go on your phone or tablet. Your cards and win stats also save between all devices and servers. Private servers are free to rent to play specifically with your friends! 📱

games.name: SCP: Facility Breach
games.desc:
SCP: Facility Breach is a casual round-based horror game that features many roles and factions to play as, with many possessing unique abilities! Massacre everyone as an anomalous entity, raid the facility as an invading insurgency, protect the Foundation as a Task Force soldier, lay waste to the EVERYTHING as Valravn, or simply evade and escape. It's up to you.

CONTROLS
Drop Item - (Keyboard: Q) (Controller: Down)
Sprint - (Keyboard: Left Shift) (Controller: Left Trigger)
Interact - (Keyboard: E) (Controller: X)
